description:
The story is about the childhood, youth, and hard lifepath of Kim Dae-jun, who was dreaming about having the ship but was destined to become the president of the Republic of Korea. He will face a lot of troubles and misunderstandings on his way. There is also a place for friendship and love. Although it is based on a true story, there are some fictional moments for entertainment.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/1324), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4294000081), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54294490), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/kim), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/kimdaejung), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4833551), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_daejung_wz), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/5451), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=2alj), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H039386675), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H039386675), MeToon

**Official Translations:**  
English, French, German, Spanish, B.Portuguese, Italian
